title: Sheinbaum Dismisses Alleged US Memorandum for Greater Collaboration in Mexican Territory
author: Alonso Urrutia and Lilian Hernández
content:
_This article by[Alonso Urrutia and Lilian
Hernández](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/Alonso%20Urrutia%20y%20Lilian%20Hern%C3%A1ndez)
originally appeared in the [October 26, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/10/26/politica/sheinbaum-
desestima-supuesto-memorandum-de-eu-para-mayor-colaboracion-en-territorio-
mexicano), Mexico's premier left wing daily newspaper._

**Mexico City**. Referring to a report in _The New York Times_ about a
memorandum sent by the United States government to her government to have
greater bilateral collaboration in national territory, President Claudia
Sheinbaum dismissed the existence of this document. However, she said that
pushing for more collaboration in Mexico **has been a recurring request from
the Donald Trump administration**.

She stressed that **this possibility has always been rejected because
operations in Mexico correspond only to Mexican authorities**. At her press
conference, the president asserted that her vision is far from the one that
prevailed during the Felipe Calderón administration, **when operations by US
personnel in Mexico were accepted**.

In this administration, she said, we coordinate, but if they have information
they provide it to us and Mexican forces carry out the actions in national
territory.

She explained, for example, that **mirror operations were recently carried out
on the Tamaulipas border** when there was an alert about alleged shots fired
into US territory from Mexico. That is the type of coordination in which each
government does its part in its own territory.

She said that the Donald Trump government has repeatedly insisted on this
participation of US personnel in Mexico, but this possibility has always been
rejected, since in Mexico only Mexican authorities operate.
